notes.title: Steering Wheels
notes.content:
Two new working Steering Wheel props were just added:
[previewyoutube=KORzAmnF3Sc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
https://youtu.be/KORzAmnF3Sc

Use standalone to create steering wheel animations. Or create a custom vehicle/car interior reference mesh scenes and is simple to add a steering wheel and align it quickly! 

For the helm of ships you can hover the vr laser on the wheel to reveal the prop menu and click the "+" button, then scale the wheel to ship scale. Or to any scale for any purpose!

Other creative ideas:
[list]
[*] gokarts, forklifts, boats.
[*] rope pulley or rope hoist crank.
[*] controls for a steam locomotive.
[*] bank vault door locking wheel.
[*] a water valve open/close animation.
[*] industrial machinery - moving a manual mill/lathe.
[*] as some DJ turntables scratch animations.
[*] etc..
[/list]
The wheel animations are included when exporting scenes to Blender. Add a steering wheel prop anywhere and start recording mocap, Grab the wheel using single or dual controllers. The wheel rotates with the controllers, while the avatar's hands remain attached to the steering wheel mesh.

This feature is still beta! Please give the YT video a like!

notes.title: Steam WORKSHOP (beta)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qk5VtJX.gif[/img]

Upload custom Avatars and assets on Steam Workshop for others to browse and download.
Props and Scenes may also be uploaded or downloaded ([i]optionally include open-format .fbx and textures[/i]).

[i]VR and non-VR menus, search and subscribe to items entirely in-game or using Steam's online site.[/i]

[b]Please help improve the Workshop![/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Upload items and avatars so more assets will be available for other users !![/i]
[*] [i]Please post reviews on cool items or give thumbs up for assets you like or use often !![/i]
[/list]
Thank you to everyone for helping to build this truly wonderful community ❤

notes.title: Multiplayer Motion Capture
notes.content:
New Multiplayer update. Create motion capture with other players, instantly export multi-avatar motion capture to Blender. Includes chat worlds and motion capture worlds. Create motion capture with other players, then export multi-avatar scenes and motion capture directly to Blender for final rendering. 

[b]Multiplayer Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Browse and host chat worlds, online motion capture worlds, avatar worlds.
[*] VOIP and avatar lipsync blendshapes supported.
[*] Full body tracking supported.
[*] Finger tracking (Quest 2, mocap gloves, index controllers) supported.
[*] New FPV mode for non-vr players, mouse/keyboard control supported.
[*] Custom avatars, worlds, props and shaders supported. 
[/list]
